title.name: The Life of Shrimp
title.tagline: A calm game about the life of a shrimp
title.keys: Arrow keys to choose, Enter to confirm
notice.notKept: This browser is not keeping settings. Changes last until the page is closed.
pause.title: Pause
controls.title: Controls
controls.help: Arrows choose a slot. Enter changes it. Backspace clears it. Escape goes back. Changes save at once.
controls.msg.locked: Escape always opens the pause menu.
controls.msg.reserved: That key belongs to the browser. Choose another.
controls.msg.lastKey: Every action keeps at least one key.
controls.msg.wouldUnbind: {other} would be left with no key. Give it a second key first.
controls.msg.unbound: {key} was {other}. {other} is now unbound in slot {slot}.
controls.msg.resetConfirm: Press Enter again to restore the default keys.
narr.c0.start: The tide carries you. You are very small.
narr.c0.change: Your body is not the same as before.
narr.c0.others: You are not the only one drifting.
narr.c0.brown: The water turns warm and brown.
narr.c0.land: Something solid, at last. You hold on.
narr.c1.arrive: Mud under your legs. You can walk.
narr.c1.senseHint: The water carries more than you can see.
narr.c1.sensed: Now you taste where things are.
narr.c1.cover: Under here, the water is still.
narr.c1.birdGone: The shadow is gone. Your legs loosen.
narr.c1.wary: It is gone. You keep close to the roots anyway.
narr.c1.greet: Her antennae touch yours. You know her now.
narr.c1.tight: Your shell has become too small.
narr.c1.soft: Everything touches you. You are soft.
narr.c1.hard: You are firm again. And larger.
narr.c1.salt: That way, the water tastes of salt.
narr.c1.closed: Too open, out there. Not yet.
narr.mood.calm: Nothing asks anything of you. You are calm.
narr.mood.hungry: Something in you pulls toward the green. You are hungry.
narr.mood.content: Your whole body settles. You are content.
narr.mood.curious: Something you do not know yet. You are curious.
narr.mood.social: You are not alone. It feels like warmth.
narr.mood.afraid: Your body pulls tight. You are afraid.
narr.veryHungry: Your body asks again. Follow the green.
narr.tired: Your tail has nothing left for now.
narr.frozen: You do not move. Not one leg.
narr.favourite: This one. This is the one you like best.
narr.tooFast: You moved too fast. She is afraid of you.
narr.cornered: Dark. Still. You are all here.
end.continued: The rest of the life is being made. Stay here as long as you like.
